about_short_description.short_description: Loyyal empowers businesses to build, scale, & monetize loyalty programs via AI and blockchain, connecting enterprises, SMEs & rewards.

product.name: Loyyal Blockchain-as-a-Service Platform
product.description: A blockchain-based enterprise platform for creating, managing, and connecting loyalty programs, rewards, partnerships, and point-based value exchanges.

product.name: Access Point
product.description: A loyalty partnership management system that automates merchant and reward-partner onboarding, contracting, connectivity, reporting, and ongoing relationship management.

product.name: Xpand Point
product.description: A blockchain-powered loyalty points exchange platform that enables real-time transfers between programs while supporting partner contracts, settlement, exchange rates, and liability management.

product.name: Reward Point
product.description: A rewards management module and merchant directory covering travel, lifestyle, leisure, experiences, gift currencies, and Web3 rewards such as NFTs, phygital items, and crypto assets.

product.name: Perk Point
product.description: A loyalty management platform for SMEs and direct-to-consumer brands, providing program configuration, points and rewards management, personalized engagement, and CRM or POS integrations.

product.name: GiftOS Point
product.description: A gift card issuance and management system for retailers, brands, malls, and retail destinations, supporting digital cards, omnichannel redemption, fraud controls, reconciliation, and analytics.
